_meta._note: Wave 8 — CASP12-15 protein folding GDT-TS progression backfill. STRICT-ATTRIBUTION: each (model_id, benchmark_id, value) triple must be visible together on a primary source. CASP14 / AlphaFold2 = 92.4 (median GDT overall across all CASP14 targets) is verified from the DeepMind official blog announcement (https://www.deepmind.google/discover/blog/alphafold-a-solution-to-a-50-year-old-grand-challenge-in-biology/), exact quote: 'our latest AlphaFold system achieves a median score of 92.4 GDT overall across all targets'. CASP12 (Zhang/Baker top), CASP13 (AlphaFold v1), and CASP15 (Yang-Server / RoseTTAFold) primary-source GDT-TS values were NOT verifiable — predictioncenter.org rankings publish z-scores rather than raw GDT-TS, the AlphaFold-v1 Nature paper s41586-019-1923-7 abstract reports TM-score (>=0.7 for 24/43 FM domains) not GDT_TS, and AlphaFold-v1 model_id is not in the DB anyway. Per the strict-attribution rule (no extrapolation; skip un-verified triples) only the CASP14 / AlphaFold2 score is ingested. Benchmark stubs casp12_gdt / casp13_gdt / casp15_gdt are still registered so future ingest waves can populate them when primary-source values are obtained.
